title.en: Kimi now runs Moonshot's Kimi Code CLI
title.zh: Kimi 现已接入 Moonshot 官方的 Kimi Code CLI

description.en: The Kimi agent previously talked to Moonshot's API directly and never ran Moonshot's own coding agent. It now drives Kimi Code CLI, so tool use, file edits and multi-turn sessions behave the way they do in the terminal. Both sign-in methods are supported: run kimi login to use your Kimi subscription, or enter a Moonshot API key. If the CLI is not installed, the previous direct-API mode still works, so existing agents are unaffected.
description.zh: 此前 Kimi 智能体仅直连 Moonshot 接口，并不会运行 Moonshot 官方的编程智能体。现在它会驱动 Kimi Code CLI，因此工具调用、文件修改与多轮会话的表现与在终端中一致。两种登录方式均受支持：既可执行 kimi login 使用 Kimi 订阅，也可填入 Moonshot API 密钥。若未安装该命令行工具，原有的接口直连模式仍然可用，已配置的智能体不受影响。

title.en: Agents already installed on your machine are now detected
title.zh: 已在本机安装的 Agent 现在能被正确识别

description.en: Agents you had installed yourself — OpenCode, Pi and others — could show up as "not installed" even though they ran fine in a terminal. When the app is opened from the Dock or Start menu it does not inherit your shell's environment, so it never saw where those CLIs live. It now reads the same PATH your terminal uses, and additionally looks in the install locations used by the OpenCode installer, pnpm, bun, yarn, Deno, custom npm prefixes, every installed Node version under nvm, and the asdf/mise, Scoop and Chocolatey shim directories.
description.zh: 此前你自行安装的 Agent（如 OpenCode、Pi 等）可能显示为“未安装”，即便它们在终端里可以正常运行。原因是从程序坞或开始菜单启动应用时，应用不会继承终端的环境变量，因此看不到这些命令行工具的实际位置。现在应用会读取与终端一致的 PATH，并额外检查 OpenCode 官方安装脚本、pnpm、bun、yarn、Deno、自定义 npm 安装前缀、nvm 下所有已安装的 Node 版本，以及 asdf/mise、Scoop 和 Chocolatey 的可执行文件目录。

title.en: Globally installed agents now report their version and offer updates
title.zh: 全局安装的 Agent 现在会显示版本并提示更新

description.en: An agent installed outside the launcher showed no version at all, so it was never reported as out of date — the agent list could read "0 updates" next to a CLI old enough to be refused by its own service. The version is now read from the CLI the launcher actually runs. Relatedly, when Codex rejects a run because the selected model needs a newer CLI, the message now says so in plain words and points at the update, instead of showing the raw service response.
description.zh: 在启动器之外安装的 Agent 此前完全不显示版本，因此永远不会被判定为需要更新——即便该命令行工具已旧到被其服务端拒绝，Agent 列表仍显示“0 个待更新”。现在版本直接读取自启动器实际运行的那个命令行工具。相应地，当 Codex 因所选模型需要更新版本而拒绝执行时，提示会直接说明原因并指向更新入口，而不再展示服务端返回的原始内容。
